warnings: Ground-floor socket plan. Home runs are tagged by circuit number, which is what ties this sheet to EE-02's single line: 3/CU and 4/CU are the two ground-floor socket circuits (F3, F4) and 6/CU is the ground-floor water heater (F6).

*** THAT TAGGING RESOLVES EE-02's CIRCUIT ALLOCATION COMPLETELY. *** F3 serves the west half of the ground floor, F4 the east half including both weatherproof outlets, F6 the ground-floor water heater. EE-06 covers F5 and F7 upstairs.
MOUNTING HEIGHTS COME FROM EE-01, NOT FROM THIS SHEET -- sockets 0.45 m, weatherproof 1.30 m, RJ45 0.45 m. None is repeated here.
The two WP weatherproof outlets are at the laundry and in the car port, the only two semi-exterior positions.

*** THE JWH WATER-HEATER BOX IS DRAWN AND CIRCUITED, BUT NO WATER HEATER IS SCHEDULED ANYWHERE IN THE ARCHITECTURAL OR SANITARY SETS. *** A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list has no heater and SN-08's basin detail calls hot water '(ถ้ามี)'. The electrical set provides the supply; nothing provides the appliance.

Socket and RJ45 counts are read off the drawn symbols -- there is no outlet schedule in the set. RE-COUNTED AT HIGH ZOOM 2026-07-28: standard sockets 11 (confirmed), WP 2 (confirmed), RJ45 corrected 3 -> 2, and TWO เต้ารับทีวี (dot-in-circle, 0.90 m per EE-01) were recovered that the first pass had missed/miscounted as RJ45. Symbol key: striped circle = socket, Ⓒ = RJ45, dot-in-circle = TV outlet.
Despite the sheet title, NO TV diagram appears on this sheet; it is drawn on EE-06 only. The title is carried across both sheets.
